content:
Apple today unveiled three flagship new iPhone models: the iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, and the foldable iPhone Duo. Here is an overview of the main differences between each model.

Design and dimensions: foldable versus traditional

This is the most obvious difference, but still worth mentioning. The iPhone Duo adopts a completely different form factor: it is a foldable device. The iPhone 18 Pro, on the other hand, offers the traditional iPhone experience.

If you have never used a foldable phone before, it is difficult to explain how the two models actually feel different in everyday use. Generally speaking, the iPhone Duo essentially combines an iPhone and an iPad in one device. However, the shape and size of its screen differ from those of a traditional iPhone, so it may take some time to get used to.

Below is a comparison of the dimensions of each model:

The iPhone Duo appears slimmer than the iPhone 18 Pro Max, but its overall weight is slightly higher.

Display: dual-screen versus single-screen, with different sizes

The iPhone Duo comes with two screens — a 5.4-inch outer screen and a 7.6-inch foldable inner screen.

The iPhone 18 Pro is available in two sizes: a standard 6.3-inch version or a 6.9-inch Pro Max model.

As a result, the Duo offers a "compact iPhone" experience while its inner screen is larger than that of the iPhone 18 Pro Max.

The foldable screen of the iPhone Duo features a nano-texture coating, a first for iPhone.

Cameras: the iPhone 18 Pro has a clear advantage

The camera is one of the most important features of an iPhone. In this respect, the iPhone 18 Pro is clearly the winner.

The iPhone 18 Pro comes with a brand-new 48-megapixel main camera and supports a variable aperture. The iPhone Duo does not have a variable aperture, so its main camera performance falls short of the Pro series.

The iPhone 18 Pro also includes a telephoto lens, which the iPhone Duo does not have.

In terms of software features, each model has its own exclusive functions:

  • iPhone Duo: Smart Take, Kid Cue, Duo Preview
  • iPhone 18 Pro: Smart Focus Tracking, Pro Controls, Apple Reference Image

The iPhone 18 Pro also exclusively supports external ProRes video recording (up to 4K 60fps), a "studio-grade four-microphone array," 1080p 30fps spatial video recording, spatial photos, ProRes RAW, Genlock, and more.

Battery: excellent battery life across all models

Because the iPhone Duo has two screens, its stated battery life varies depending on which screen is being used. Overall, however, Apple promises that both the Duo and the iPhone 18 Pro deliver strong battery performance.

Below are the figures released by Apple:

  • iPhone Duo outer screen: up to 44 hours
  • iPhone Duo inner screen: up to 31 hours
  • iPhone 18 Pro: up to 36 hours
  • iPhone 18 Pro Max: up to 45 hours

Everyone's usage habits are different, but if you take the average of the iPhone Duo's two battery life estimates, the average video playback time is roughly 38 hours.

Other differences: Face ID, buttons, software, Apple Pencil, and more

The iPhone Duo and the iPhone 18 Pro use different authentication methods — the former uses Touch ID, while the latter uses Face ID.

The iPhone Duo does not feature an Action button, but offers Camera Control.

The iPhone Duo benefits from several multitasking advantages in iOS 27, such as support for split-view app usage and a unique landscape display mode. Other fun software features have also been added, such as a half-folded StandBy mode.

The iPhone Duo will support the Apple Pencil (USB-C model) later this year, which is another advantage over the iPhone 18 Pro.

Both the iPhone Duo and the iPhone 18 Pro come with the new C2 modem, but the iPhone 18 Pro Max does not.

The iPhone 18 Pro is available in Burgundy, Glacier, Black, and Silver. The iPhone Duo comes in only two colours: Star White and Night Sky.

Finally, the body materials differ: the iPhone 18 Pro uses a unibody aluminium design, while the iPhone Duo uses titanium.

Price and availability: a clear gap between the two

Pricing is another major difference between Apple's new devices. Below are the starting prices for the 256GB models:

  • iPhone Duo: US$1,999
  • iPhone 18 Pro: US$1,199
  • iPhone 18 Pro Max: US$1,299

The iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max will be available for pre-order this Saturday and will ship next Friday (18 September). The iPhone Duo will not open for pre-orders until 16 October, with shipping beginning on 23 October.
